# The Canadian Immigration

> Online platform for applying for Canada eTA/e-Visa with application tracking, fee information, and support services for international travelers.

The Canadian Immigration provides streamlined electronic travel authorization (eTA) services for citizens of visa-exempt countries seeking to enter Canada. The platform offers step-by-step application guidance, real-time status tracking, and multilingual support across 15+ countries including Australia, UK, Japan, Singapore, Mexico, and the US.

## Key Topics

- Canada eTA
- Electronic Travel Authorization

## Core Application Services

- [Get a Canada e-Visa/eTA online - Canada Immigration Services](https://www.thecanadianimmigration.org): Homepage for Canada eTA/e-visa online application services
- [Apply for a Canada eVisa - Step 1](https://www.thecanadianimmigration.org/apply-visa): Step-by-step Canada eVisa application form and requirements guide
- [How to apply for a Canadian eta in 3 easy steps](https://www.thecanadianimmigration.org/faq/how-it-works): Three-step guide for applying for Canada eTA online
- [Make Payment](https://www.thecanadianimmigration.org/make-payment): Secure online payment processing for Canada eTA visa fees
- [Check Canada eta visa status - Canada e-Visa/eTA Service](https://www.thecanadianimmigration.org/check-status): Track progress of Canada eTA visa applications with status checker
